decision_record.transfer: Absorption/breakout timing edge on 4h ENJUSDT bars: forced sellers (shock bar) / breakout buyers pay for immediacy; the surplus exists only near the confirming close — a late entry buys the same fixed 16h/96h hold after the information is public and the price_hint is stale.
decision_record.comparison: Price-aware baseline = the pre-change sleeve itself (shadow control): enters on the latest completed bar's signal at any age. Treatment differs only inside the gate below.
decision_record.mechanism: Stale-signal entry leak: the source design entered inside a 300s window after its entry delay; the v3 translation dropped the window and no producer/dispatcher layer enforces it, so entries fired up to 4h late in normal cycling and indefinitely on a stale snapshot (outage/restart replay), sized full-cash/volume-capped off the stale close.
decision_record.calculation: signal_age_s = now - (signal_bar_t + 4h) (bar t = open). Measured pre-change: entry fired at age 7200s and 43200s on the fixture signal (10/10 ENJ sleeves). Treatment window [0, 900s] = the sleeves' own declared producer freshness SLA (aster_batch7 PRODUCERS freshness_sla_s=900) at the 300s cadence (first 3 cycles after close). Cost of refusal = the missed late entries the shadow control keeps scoring; cost of the leak = full slice deployed at a stale close into a fixed hold.
decision_record.experiment: Pre-registered: fixture A/B on identical opportunities — fresh (age 0) must enter ON and OFF identically; stale (age 7200s) must enter OFF (control) and refuse ON (treatment); boundary 900s enters / 901s refuses; deadline exit at stale age must still fire ON. Rejection rule: any fresh-entry divergence ON vs OFF, or any gated exit, kills the enhancement. Blockers: tests/test_harden_edge_batch7_blockers.py (fail-first proven: 4 ENJ tests fail with the engine change stashed).
